name: Concurrent load with data verification, lock contention and connection recovery

tasks.name: Mount the file system and install the load generator
commands: which fio || apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 install -y fio

tasks.name: Concurrent direct writes with checksum verification
Advisory lock contention across processes
commands: for p in $(seq 1 4); do ( for i in $(seq 1 50); do flock "${DIR}/counter.lock" -c "n=\$(cat '${DIR}/counter'); echo \$((n+1)) > '${DIR}/counter'"; done ) & done; wait

tasks.name: Write a canary file before interrupting the connection
commands: dd if=/dev/urandom of="${DIR}/canary.bin" bs=1M count=64 status=none conv=fsync

tasks.name: Block Lustre traffic on the client and observe the client reaction
commands: ( dd if=/dev/urandom of="${DIR}/during-outage.bin" bs=1M count=64 conv=fsync status=none; echo "background write exit: $?" > /tmp/outage-write-status ) &
lctl get_param -n osc.*.state 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'current_state' | sort | uniq -c || true

tasks.name: Restore traffic and confirm the client recovers
commands: lctl get_param -n osc.*.state 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'current_state' | sort | uniq -c || true
dd if=/dev/urandom of="${DIR}/after-recovery.bin" bs=1M count=64 status=none conv=fsync

tasks.name: Decode the kernel taint and scan for client faults
commands: python3 -c "import sys; bits={0:'proprietary module',1:'forced module load',2:'cpu out of spec',3:'forced rmmod',4:'machine check',5:'bad page',6:'user set',7:'died recently',9:'warning issued',10:'staging driver',11:'firmware workaround',12:'out-of-tree module',13:'unsigned module',14:'soft lockup'}; v=int(sys.argv[1]); print('taint bits set:', ', '.join(f'{k} ({n})' for k,n in bits.items() if v>>k & 1) or 'none')" "${TAINT}"
echo '--- out-of-tree and unsigned taint origin ---'
dmesg | grep -iE 'taints kernel|module verification failed' | head -5 || echo 'no taint message'
echo '--- client faults: BUG, oops, call trace, lockup ---'
if dmesg | grep -iE 'BUG:|Oops|Call Trace|general protection|NULL pointer dereference|soft lockup|hung task'; then echo 'FAULTS FOUND'; else echo 'none'; fi
echo '--- kernel warnings raised at runtime, boot-time CPU notices excluded ---'
if dmesg | grep -E 'WARNING:' | grep -viE 'RETBleed|Spectre|i8042|IMA'; then echo 'RUNTIME WARNINGS FOUND'; else echo 'none'; fi
dmesg | grep -o 'LustreError: [0-9-]*[:-][^:]*' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10 || echo 'none'
